s: Badrutt's Palace's champagne-and-DJ mountain club above St. Moritz
w: Run by the storied Badrutt's Palace hotel but perched up at Corviglia rather than in town, Paradiso plays St. Moritz's glamorous side straight -- Champagne, a DJ, and a designer-clad crowd against Engadin peaks, continuing the resort's Slim Aarons-era reputation for elevated, photogenic après. Reached by cable car from the village.
_facts: Located at the Corviglia mountain station above St. Moritz, operated by Badrutt's Palace Hotel
Combines a restaurant and mountain club/bar with DJ sets and Champagne service
Reached via the Corviglia funicular/cable car from St. Moritz village
Continues St. Moritz's long-standing reputation as a glamorous, high-society ski destination
